subject: *: move XXInfo/Job, etc, out from model pkg in parser to meta (#55754)
summary: Reviewed the type move from `pkg/parser/model` to `pkg/meta/model` and the corresponding `pkg/ddl`, `pkg/infoschema`, and `pkg/meta` updates in the scoped DDL/add-index/metadata paths. The changes are predominantly mechanical (imports/identifier renames like AutoId→AutoID) while preserving persisted metadata JSON tags (e.g. `auto_id_cache`) and `ActionType` numeric values, and I found no plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness, metadata-compatibility, or state-machine/concurrency issues in these areas.
